claims.text: LLMs learn to infer latent concepts during pretraining.
A prompt-response concept model explains how LLMs generate responses.
Response uncertainty in LLMs decreases as prompt informativeness increases.
LLM response uncertainty reduction with informative prompts is analogous to epistemic uncertainty behavior.

evidence.description: Validated through experimental results on real-world datasets.

methodologies.name: Prompt-Response Concept Model
methodologies.description: A conceptual framework based on latent concept inference during pretraining to analyze prompt-uncertainty dynamics in LLMs.

limitations.text: LLM reliability in critical decision-making tasks such as healthcare is not well-established.
